essay.title: CENTS & digital objecthood
essay.author: shibboleth
essay.subtitle: an introduction to the primary concepts of CENTS by Rutherford Chang

shots.purpose: Open on the discrepancy the project starts from, as two values that do not meet. The coin itself sits behind the figure.
Name the work and credit the essay and its author at first title. CENT #3981 behind the title, so the work is seen before it is described.
Show the scale of the sort: a hundred thousand pennies reduced to ten thousand pre-1982 coppers.
The making, in the order the narration gives it, ending on the master object.
Show the digital Block itself at the moment it is named.
Show what a full-block inscription looks like in the chain: the transactions a block would hold, beside the one inscription that filled it instead.
Close the making on the release, with the chain completed.
